description: Get patent details by publication number (e.g. "US11027025B2", "EP3904939B1", "US20260240819A1"). Sections: abstract, claims (US fulltext via USPTO Public Search; EP/WO via EPO OPS when configured, otherwise Google Patents pages — see per-section source fields), citations (backward + forward), family, classifications. US claims may fall back to an unofficial Google Patents rendering when PPUBS is slow or unreachable — flagged in _warnings. Section failures are reported per section (inline error entry plus a _warnings note), never by failing the whole call.
name: patent_get
